metadata.title: The Drowned Lamp Cycle
metadata.premise: A false light on the Black Tooth was never only a wrecker's trick. Three books carry one party from the tide-flooded lamp room of Sablewrack Isle, through a drowned parish whose bell has started ringing again, to the burnt inland road where the order that taught the coast to lie is finally holding court. Levels 1 to 7. What the party owes the Ashbound at the end of the first book is what they can call on in the third.
metadata.narrationVoice: Plain, salt-worn, and specific. Weather and tide are always doing something. Never explain a horror that the party could still walk away from.

books.title: Book I — The False Beacon
books.note: The party leaves the isle owed a favour by the Ashbound, whichever way the wreck-pickers fall. `allied-wizards` is the debt; it is not spent until Book III.

books.title: Book II — The Bell at Saltmire
books.note: Gated on Book I finishing at all, rather than on how it finished — the coast road only opens once the wrecking stops.

books.title: Book III — The Cindergate Road
books.note: The debt comes due. `allied-wizards`, carried from Book I, opens the Ashbound escort's hidden trail, the watchtower signal, and the key-rune at the sealed cairn — three options that are invisible to a party that arrives here without it.
